summary: Full e2e backend (pytest, 10/10) + frontend (Playwright) verification of the Document Intelligence Platform. Real Gemini 3 Pro extraction, mock S3 ingestion, async job state, RFC 7807 errors, correlation-id echo and RBAC all verified end-to-end through the external ingress.

backend: test_sync_extract_s3_uri_real_gemini -> 200, model=gemini-3.1-pro-preview, mock=false, structured+markdown present, correlationId echoed
test_sync_extract_multipart_upload -> 200, structured JSON from uploaded .md file
test_async_extract_and_poll_completion -> 202 PENDING -> polled to COMPLETED with structured result (~9s)
frontend: JWT auto-minted into jwt-input on load (240 chars, JWT format)
Switch to S3 tab + sync mode + Run Extraction -> json-output rendered
Switch to async mode + Run Extraction -> job-status-badge PENDING -> COMPLETED in ~9s, result rendered in json-output

critical_code_review_comments: Job polling interval (1.5s) in App.js never sends an updated Authorization header if the user re-mints the token while a job is in flight; not a functional bug today but worth noting for prod hardening.
create_mock_token signs the token with `aud` and decode_token validates that audience, but no `iss` validation is enforced - acceptable for a mock OIDC layer but mention in docs.
CORS is wildcard (allow_origins=['*']) with allow_credentials=True - works for the demo but should be tightened to the ingress origin before production.

Sync 5MB cap returns 413 with a helpful message - good. Consider also returning a problem+json `errors` field to be fully RFC 7807 compliant (currently only `title`/`detail`/`status`/`correlationId` are present).
test_credentials: Mock OIDC - mint via POST /api/v1/auth/token with {sub, roles:['extractor','admin']}. Viewer role used to verify 403.
seed_data_creation: None - S3 ingestion is mocked (USE_MOCK_S3=true), returns a sample invoice for any s3:// URI. Async jobs persisted in SQLite (jobs.db).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_extraction_api.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/test_extraction_api.py -v`. Real Gemini calls take ~5-12s so SYNC_TIMEOUT=60s and ASYNC_POLL_TIMEOUT=45s. External URL is the only correct base (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL); /health and /ready are k8s-only so always use /api/health and /api/ready externally. App is fully working as of this iteration.
